.husky/pre-commit.local.IMPLICIT: a commit staging the library, its bundle or a log runs that file's validator and is refused on any fault it prints: data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or images/ run `node validate.js --staged`; data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or data/vault-data.js run `node bundle.js --staged`, refusing a bundle that does not match the staged JSON (#32); data/round-log.jsonl runs `node round-log.js --staged` (#95) and data/corrections-log.jsonl `node corrections-log.js --staged` (#166), each refusing a malformed row, a change to a committed row beyond adding its final_pick, rejections or on_weakest (round log) or answering its pending ruling (corrections log), or a git it cannot read; data/calibration-log.jsonl runs `node calibration-log.js --staged` (#168), refusing a malformed row, a run whose figures disagree with the disagreements listed under it, any change to or removal of a committed row, or a git it cannot read.
.husky/pre-commit.local.JUSTIFIED: fail-safe — a malformed library entry travels into every brief copied from it, and a stale bundle shows the page a version behind with nothing saying so; the logs hold the founder's first picks, his corrections in his own words and the critic's calibration figures, from whose last row round-log.js counts calibration due, none of which can be recovered once rewritten; the commit is the last local moment to catch each (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3631 step 2).
.husky/pre-commit.local.DEFEAT: none — fix the fault the validator names, run node bundle.js and commit data/vault-data.js with the JSON, or append a new log row; a commit that touches none of these paths runs none of them.
